instructions.purpose: Create an event on the structurally protected writable calendar.

tool.name: create-calendar-event
tool.description: Creates timed, all-day, or Google-native recurring events. It cannot select a calendar.

usage_rules.rule: A date without a time is all-day. If a timed start has no end or duration, the service defaults to one hour.
Return materially ambiguous dates or starts to Main before calling.
Use the configured timezone unless the user specifies another.
Use only RRULE:, RDATE:, and EXDATE: recurrence lines.

example.context: Create an all-day event called Holiday on 2026-08-01.
